This is modeled as a deterministic system with no emergent behavior. The system's honesty is verified through test suites that lock invariants such as the absence of fake-green indicators. The DB persistence gap is a known limitation, but it is mitigated by graceful degradation into in-memory storage, which preserves integrity. The cockpit visualization zone is explicitly read-only, ensuring no unauthorized control flow. These primitives form a closed-loop system where safety gates are never weakened, and all components are either fully functional or safely inert.
